THEN SMALL PROPS (about 85 items, each isolated): 10 trees (jacarandas in bloom, eucalyptus, palm trees, mulemba fig, mango, avocado, bougainvillea); 6 street lamps; 4 wooden electricity poles; 2 blue-and-white candongueiro minibuses; 4 kupapata motorbikes; 3 cars; 6 zungueira and market stalls; 4 waste containers; 4 benches; 3 rooftop water tanks; 2 generators; 2 bus-stop shelters; 4 flower pots; 3 bicycles; 4 piles of cement blocks; 2 wheelbarrows; 3 yellow jerrycans; 3 chickens; 2 goats; 2 street signs reading 'Xipuli'; 2 Angolan flags on poles; 3 mobile-phone credit kiosks; 2 sacks of charcoal; 1 public water tap; 2 plastic table sets; 2 gas cylinders; 1 wooden cart; 2 walls with gates.
Every item fully separated by transparent space so each one can be cut out automatically.
